title: Mass and weight are different
text:
LABI do · connect mass and weight

Target K2 Pairs

Mass and weight are different

**Mass:** amount of matter/inertia, in kg.

**Weight:** gravitational force, in N.

Near Earth: use g ≈ 10 N/kg

Near Earth: use g ≈ 10 N/kg. 1 kg: 10; 2 kg: 20; 3 kg: 30. Classroom approximation: weight = mass × 10.

Classroom approximation: weight = mass × 10.
